1→{
     2→  "task_description": "Auto-Re
covery for Stuck Tasks

Overview
Add automatic self-healing for tasks that appear stuck (marked as running but no active process). The system will monitor all tasks in the background and automatically restart them up to 3 times per 3 minutes per task.

Architecture
Every 10s
For each task
Yes
No
Not running
Running
Yes
No
TaskMonitorService
Check All Tasks
Status is in_progress or ai_review?
Check if process running
Skip task
Within rate limit?
Auto-recover with restart
Log rate limit exceeded
Track restart attempt
Update restart history


Implementation Steps
1. Create Task Monitor Service
File: apps/frontend/src/main/agent/task-monitor.ts (new file)

Create TaskMonitorService class that:
Maintains a map of restart attempts per task: Map<taskId, Array<{timestamp: number}>>
Implements checkRateLimit(taskId: string): boolean - returns true if task can restart (less than 3 attempts in last 3 minutes)
Implements recordRestartAttempt(taskId: string): void - adds timestamp to restart history
Implements cleanupOldAttempts(taskId: string): void - removes attempts older than 3 minutes
Implements startMonitoring(agentManager: AgentManager, projectStore: ProjectStore): void - starts interval checking
Implements stopMonitoring(): void - stops interval
2. Integrate Monitor into AgentManager
File: apps/frontend/src/main/agent/agent-manager.ts

Add taskMonitor: TaskMonitorService property
Initialize in constructor: this.taskMonitor = new TaskMonitorService()
Add method startTaskMonitoring(projectStore: ProjectStore): void that calls this.taskMonitor.startMonitoring(this, projectStore)
Add method stopTaskMonitoring(): void that calls this.taskMonitor.stopMonitoring()
3. Start Monitoring on App Init
File: apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts (or wherever AgentManager is initialized)

After AgentManager is created and projectStore is available, call agentManager.startTaskMonitoring(projectStore)
Ensure monitoring stops on app quit
4. Monitor Logic Implementation
File: apps/frontend/src/main/agent/task-monitor.ts

The monitoring loop should:

Get all projects from projectStore
For each project, get all tasks
Filter tasks where status === 'in_progress' || status === 'ai_review'
For each active task:
Check if process is actually running via agentManager.isRunning(taskId)
If not running (stuck):
Clean up old restart attempts for this task
Check rate limit
If within limit, call recovery with auto-restart
Record restart attempt timestamp
Run every 10 seconds (configurable interval)
5. Reuse Existing Recovery Handler
File: apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/task/execution-handlers.ts

The existing TASK_RECOVER_STUCK handler already supports autoRestart: true
The monitor will call this handler's logic directly (not via IPC) or extract the recovery logic into a shared function
Extract recovery logic into: async function recoverStuckTaskInternal(taskId: string, options: { autoRestart?: boolean }): Promise<...>
Both IPC handler and monitor will use this shared function
6. Add Logging
Log when stuck task is detected: `[TaskMonitor] Detected stuck task: ${taskId}`
Log when auto-recovery is triggered: `[TaskMonitor] Auto-recovering task ${taskId} (attempt ${attemptCount})`
Log when rate limit is hit: `[TaskMonitor] Rate limit exceeded for task ${taskId}, skipping auto-recovery`
Log when task is successfully recovered: `[TaskMonitor] Successfully auto-recovered task ${taskId}`
7. Handle Edge Cases
Skip monitoring if task is already being manually recovered (add a flag)
Skip if task status changes during monitoring check
Ensure monitoring doesn't interfere with manual recovery operations
Handle projectStore not being available yet (graceful degradation)
Files to Modify
New: apps/frontend/src/main/agent/task-monitor.ts - Core monitoring service
Modify: apps/frontend/src/main/agent/agent-manager.ts - Add monitoring integration
Modify: apps/frontend/src/main/ipc-handlers/task/execution-handlers.ts - Extract recovery logic to shared function
Modify: apps/frontend/src/main/index.ts - Start monitoring on app init
Configuration
Check interval: 10 seconds (configurable constant)
Rate limit: 3 restarts per 3 minutes per task
Grace period: 2 seconds after status change before checking (to avoid false positives during process spawn)
Testing Considerations
Test rate limiting: verify that 4th restart attempt within 3 minutes is blocked
Test that rate limit resets after 3 minutes
Test that monitoring doesn't interfere with manual recovery
Test that monitoring stops when app quits",

     4→}

## Complexity Assessment Complete

| **Research Needed** | No |

### Key Findings

**Why STANDARD (not SIMPLE):**
- 4 files is within the 3-10 file STANDARD range
- New service class with its own logic (TaskMonitorService)
- Requires extraction and refactoring of existing recovery logic
- Multiple edge cases need handling (rate limiting, race conditions, grace periods)

**Why not COMPLEX:**
- Single service only (frontend main process)
- No external integrations or new dependencies
- All patterns already exist in codebase (EventEmitter, Map tracking, intervals)
- Existing recovery logic just needs extraction to shared function
- No infrastructure changes (Docker, DB, etc.)

### Recommended Phases
```
discovery → requirements → context → spec_writing → planning → validation
```
(6 phases, standard workflow without research)

### Validation Approach
- **Risk Level:** Medium
- **Tests Required:** Unit + Integration
- **Security Scan:** Not required (no auth/sensitive data changes)
- **Staging:** Not required (no infrastructure changes)
